ci_farm_substrate_canonical.purpose: Self-hostable distributed CI farm substrate (Jenkins+ArgoCD, ephemeral agents, sccache->SeaweedFS remote cache, per-microservice lane fanout, merge-queue fan-in). Authored under ADR-0349; honest-foundation.

design_spec_maturity_deferred_surfaces.purpose: Wave-3-I deferred design/spec-maturity surfaces ratchet; transparent deferral of not-yet-authored service surfaces (operational_claim stays blocked_until_operational_evidence).

cloud_control_plane_canonical.purpose: Cloud Control Plane canonical target architecture (P-TARGET): resource model (Org->...->Resource), ORN, API Gateway->Resource Registry->Operation Ledger->Workflow/Reconciler->OpenTofu/operators/Argo, per-resource quota/billing/audit contract, durable long-running operations, nine control-plane facets. Target spec; no runtime claimed.

api_contract_ssot_canonical.purpose: API contract SSOT (CS-LAUNCH-API-CONTRACT-SSOT-001): one Rust-native source generating/validating REST(OpenAPI 3.2.0)+gRPC(proto3)+GraphQL SDL; GraphQL first-class derived not hand-maintained; api-contract-ssot-drift gate. Pulsar launch-primary; Kubewarden default. Target spec; no generators/runtime claimed.

cloud_authorization_target.purpose: Cloud authorization target (P-TARGET): Cedar as universal gate for the control plane + cloud-* resources (ADR-0243); default-deny; KR/JP/US/EU pack overlays; references cedar-policy/fragment schemas. Target spec; no runtime.

cloud_observability_slo_target.purpose: Cloud observability+SLO target (P-TARGET): OpenTelemetry + measured SLOs + burn-rate + agentic SLO-gated promotion (ADR-0130/0340) for the cloud-* substrate. Target spec; no measured evidence claimed.

cloud_resource_catalog_target.purpose: Cloud resource catalog target (P-TARGET): per-resource-type architecture for all cloud-* services (IAM/KMS/Secrets/Compute/Storage/Network/Data/Billing/Capacity), each instantiating the control-plane per-resource contract (quota/billing/audit/lifecycle/slo/retention), Cedar-gated + OTel-instrumented + actuated via OpenTofu/operator/Argo. Target spec; metadata-only until P-STRANGLE.

cloud_production_quality_kits_target.purpose: Cloud production quality kits target (P-PROD): seven harness-backed evidence gates (overload/fairness, shuffle-shard isolation, privacy/data-governance, canary+PRR, FOCUS cost, K8s PSS, abuse/fraud/DDoS) each with scenarios+evidence-format+feeding production_100_bar gate. Incorporated from plan/ quality review. Target spec; no harnesses/evidence implemented.

cloud_strangler_migration_target.purpose: Strangler-fig migration playbook (P-STRANGLE): per-service pattern (seam->build-ideal->facade->shadow/canary->cutover->retire), parallel worktree-lane model + single-writer invariant + Bazel affected-targets + merge-queue fan-in, per-migration DoD, cutover/rollback criteria. Target playbook; no migration executed.

cloud_toolchain_target.purpose: Cloud toolchain target (P-TOOLCHAIN): Bazel rules_rust build graph (crate_universe SSOT, RBE, affected-targets) + Jenkins sole CI (ADR-0359, JCasC, ephemeral agents, GitHub App statuses) + nextest sharding/machete/deny/bacon + oya governance overlay delegating to bazel + merge-queue speculative + ArgoCD progressive delivery. Target spec; no adoption/runtime claimed.

phase0_ci_enforcement_baseline.purpose: P0.0 executable RED gap packet for cloud-ci/oya-ci required-context authority, trusted producer provenance, override contract, structured result output, and candidate-as-untrusted-input boundaries. It is target/non-claim evidence until live protected-branch enforcement exists.

phase0_ci_enforcement_result_schema.purpose: JSON Schema for P0.0 cloud-ci enforcement result fixtures. Requires full candidate SHA, producer, observed verdict, fixture results, provenance, and claim-boundary fields so branch-protection authority cannot be inferred from local-only evidence.

phase0_override_packet_schema.purpose: JSON Schema for P0.0 cloud-ci override packets. Requires affected required contexts, degraded gate ids, TTL, reviewer acknowledgment, audit-chain event, owner, blast radius, revert/fix follow-up, and no-new-oya-CLI marker so temporary gate disable/degrade paths cannot become untracked authority.

phase0_trusted_target_inventory_schema.purpose: JSON Schema for P0.0 trusted Buck2 target inventories. Requires target lists from trusted dev/controller state before candidate checkout, candidate bytes as untrusted input, and non-claim boundary fields so candidate-authored target discovery cannot shrink required context scope.

toolchain_tenant_isolation_fixtures.purpose: P0.0 tenant-pipeline isolation fixture contract covering runner, workspace, cache, artifact, status, secret, release-ledger, and deployment-target separation plus audited TTL breakglass target behavior.

phase0_automation_matrix.purpose: Phase-0 automation ratchet matrix. Each enforceable or automatable requirement maps to a gate, controller, generated registry, fixture, or explicit temporary human-judgment row with owner and retirement path.

phase0_claim_evidence_map.purpose: Phase-0 claim ceiling map tying regulated language to evidence tiers, explicit target/non-claim labels, current evidence, owners, and blocking paths to future live evidence.

bespoke_cloud_toolchain_services.purpose: Target service/code-shape registry for {oya,cloud}/<service> plus libs/ boundaries, deletion-tagged bridge adapters, and the Prow-shaped cloud-ci/oya-ci destination. Target spec; no runtime adoption claimed.

hyperscaler_production_readiness_claim_c.purpose: Claim-ceiling contract for terms such as production-ready, hyperscaler-grade, secure, isolated, performant, complete, retired, and tenant-facing. It defines evidence tiers and downgrade/block behavior unless live evidence is present.

buck2_authority_policy.purpose: P0.0 Buck2 authority policy: active scripts/CI/CD/build lanes use Buck2; Cargo is restricted to production release image/binary optimization evidence and metadata-only Buck2 graph generation.

phase0_automation_coverage_registry.purpose: Local/static AC-0.16 coverage registry mapping declared Phase-0 acceptance criteria, selected ADR amendments, operating-contract requirements, and governance work items to automation-matrix rows so seed-row omission cannot false-green the automation ratchet.

buck2_cargo_target_coverage.purpose: AC-0.13 local/static target-coverage contract measuring Cargo workspace lib/bin target roots, including Cargo auto-discovered src/bin binaries, against checked-in Buck2 rust crate_root mappings; records divergence without source-line coverage or live cloud-ci authority claims.

red_green_fixture_contract.purpose: AC-0.14 local/static RED/GREEN fixture registry contract requiring Phase-0 gate targets to keep checked-in GOOD, BAD, and non-claim markers; records fixture coverage without live cloud-ci authority claims.

generated_artifact_registry.purpose: AC-0.15/P0.9 seed registry for generated artifacts, source/regeneration ownership, merge-tree readiness fixtures, one-lane-one-path/path-overlap fail-closed cases, and explicit non-claims for full-repo generated-output coverage and Phase-1 Tide batching.

service_inventory.purpose: AC-0.1/P0.6/AC-0.7 local/static closed-world service, library, and pack root inventory seed used by //:service-root-classifier-check. Direct-child root coverage only; full nested crate inventory, post-migration pure split, and live required-context authority remain false.

phase0_structural_packets.purpose: P0.6 structural packet seed catalog for root inventory, oya/cloud/libs split families, flat layout, and kebab-case naming fixtures validated by //:service-root-classifier-check.

status_enum_registry.purpose: AC-0.2 local/static 3-axis decision/maturity/constraint status enum registry and status-drift fixture contract validated by //:status-enum-drift-check. Full manifest/PRD conformance and live required-context authority remain false.

adr_hygiene_registry.purpose: AC-0.3 local/static ADR numbering, supersession, and active-doc superseded-reference hygiene registry validated by //:adr-hygiene-check. Duplicate ADR-0377 is resolved by ADR-0520 renumbering and ADR-0511 is superseded_by ADR-0513; full ADR index regeneration and live required-context authority remain false.

language_discipline_registry.purpose: AC-0.4 local/static language-discipline allowlist registry validated by //:language-discipline-check. It blocks new candidate-authored .py/.sh fixture sprawl outside the bootstrap shell allowlist, records the T0.4 cloud_*_check.py backlog inventory, preserves Buck2-native LLVM coverage and dual Cargo+Buck2/Reindeer local mutation standards, and keeps live required-context/P0.0/Phase-0 readiness authority false.

d1_seam_contracts_registry.purpose: AC-0.5/AC-0.10 local/static D1 seam contract registry validated by //:d1-seam-contracts-check. It records the A2a mutation payload/result proto3 contract, A2b workflow-to-AI-step invocation signature, proto-optional consistency_token with Phase-0 fixture-required presence, and conformance-gated topology fields while keeping live D1 conformance and readiness authority false.

effective_dating_kernel_registry.purpose: Local/static AC-0.6 registry for ontology-kernel bitemporal effective-dating primitives and fixture-backed Rust/Buck2 evidence; not live cloud-ci/oya-ci authority.

cross_artifact_agreement_registry.purpose: AC-0.8 registry for ADR/spec/masterplan/roadmap agreement-set enforcement, RED/GREEN fixtures, and non-claim boundaries.

decision_propagation_packets.purpose: Executable P0.7 packet list mapping backlog decision register #1..#21 to agreement sets, generated outputs, owners, regeneration commands, and verification gates.

by_kind.spec: Schema or canonical-truth definition. Read by validators + agents.
by_kind.registry: Data plane with rows. Validators check row conformance to schema.
by_kind.policy: Decision rule (e.g., migration policy, retention policy).
by_kind.decision: Accepted ADR or decision record that constrains implementation and promotion.
by_kind.localization-pack: Jurisdiction-specific pack overview and lifecycle authority.
by_kind.localization-pack-manifest: Canonical jurisdiction-pack manifest consumed by gates and agents.
by_kind.regional-pack: Regional policy, regulatory, operational, and market-specific pack authority.

agent_quick_start_protocol.step_2_context_recall: Prefer intelligence-native context once available (replaces prior Foundry framing per ADR-0335 Wave 15I); legacy icm recall-context is compatibility/provenance only and is never promotion authority.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_3_oya_vcs_state_transition: Canonical path is plain `git` + Jenkins CI + `oya gate` (ADR-0363): work on an isolated worktree branch, push, open a PR against dev; Jenkins + `oya gate run-all` + reviewer APPROVE gate merge. The bespoke Oya VCS claim → work → verify → done → promote ratchet is RETIRED (provenance/historical only per ADR-0363); legacy grit/icm/rtk/vox/omx/omc surfaces are likewise read/provenance only.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_4_active_artifact_contract: Every new artifact under applicable_paths_glob conforms to active-artifact-contract v3.0.0 + registers a row in artifact-capabilities-registry.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_5_multispectrum_evidence: Every PR carries multispectrum evidence per /specs/multispectrum-review.json; missing or incomplete evidence blocks the governance gate (`oya gate run-all`, locally and in Jenkins CI). The legacy 'ChangeBundle promotion / Oya VCS admission' framing is provenance-only per ADR-0363.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_6_gitops_vcs_replacement: Before broad multi-agent fan-out, honor /specs/gitops-vcs-replacement.json as a HISTORICAL contract: the bespoke Oya VCS claim coverage, ChangeBundle closeout, controller rebase, and merge-queue mechanisms are RETIRED per ADR-0363 (which supersedes ADR-0110/0112/0113). The live substrate is plain git + Jenkins CI + `oya gate` + reviewer APPROVE; merge-queue is deferred (auto-merge + required checks suffice per ADR-0363 §3).
